fields.description: Which calls become CRM Call Logs. EMPTY CAPTURES NOTHING -- this table decides, and it ships blank on purpose. To start logging inbound Dialer calls, add one row: Acefone / Inbound / Dialer / Capture. A call that no rule captures is still logged raw (Integration Request) and stays replayable; it just does not become a Call Log. A call on a number that is not in CRM Telephony DID is dropped regardless of this table -- that is what keeps other businesses off a shared provider account out of this CRM.
fields.label: Capture Rules
